stances.summary: Critiques economic policies or outcomes affecting working economy
Explores Trump's unconventional economic approach on finance and trade
stances.quote: Trump's Economic Revolution with Stephen Miran. The former chair of the Council of Economic Advisors discusses the new vision on finance, banking, and trade, and why economists can't make sense of it.

stances.summary: Defends prioritizing American interests as compatible with economic freedom
stances.quote: ‘Common Good’ Capitalism Preserves Freedom (by Fred Bauer). Prioritizing Americans is less an apostasy from freedom than a prerequisite for preserving it.

stances.summary: USMCA must be strengthened to prevent Chinese economic penetration
stances.quote: Slam The USMCA Back Door (by Nicholas Phillips). For the trade agreement to survive, it must keep China out of North America.

stances.summary: Questions GDP-based metrics for measuring cross-border prosperity
stances.quote: Is Kansas Richer than Canada? with Jeff Reimer and Brian Dijkema (by Chris Griswold). Two writers travel to both sides of the border to understand what metrics can’t capture.

stances.summary: Public education should instill civic virtues and shared national allegiances
stances.quote: The Citizenship Test. Public education must instill civic virtues and shared allegiances.

stances.summary: Argues meritocratic systems require moral foundations
Promotes self-governance and civic participation in education
stances.quote: The School of Self-Rule (by Bruno V. Manno)

stances.summary: Expresses concern about surveillance and tracking of young children
stances.quote: But Who Monitors the Baby Monitors?. Team Compass on the tragic trend toward toddler-tracking technology.

stances.summary: Questions whether AI singularity is occurring and its implications
stances.quote: Is the AI Apocalypse Already Here? with Gregory Conti. Are we living through the singularity? Does it matter?

stances.summary: Distinguishes anti-family opposition from pro-family advocacy in conservative policy
stances.quote: Anti-Anti-Family Policy Is Not Pro-Family (by Leah Libresco Sargeant). Conservatives must learn the difference between the two.

stances.summary: Explores federalism and state-level policy experimentation
Explores challenges of pregnancy in contemporary public context
Criticizes overreliance on expert authority in public discourse
stances.quote: With All Due Respect to the Experts (by Oliver Traldi). On the difficulty and importance of protecting the public square from the cult of expertise.

stances.summary: Critiques economist Paul Krugman's policy positions or predictions
stances.quote: Next Stop on the Krugman Apology Tour

stances.summary: Political realignment requires sustained economic messaging beyond elections
stances.quote: Realignments Are Built After Election Day (by Henry Olsen). Primaries don't sell a shift in economic thinking. But learning from Reagan can. By Henry Olsen

stances.summary: EU's restrictive immigration stance may isolate American progressive left
stances.quote: Nothing Left in Europe (by Ryan James Girdusky). The EU’s rightward turn on immigration could leave American liberals on an island.
